title: Eye measurement before cataract surgery (biometry)
what: A machine measures the length of your eye and the curve of your cornea. These numbers are used to choose the artificial lens for surgery.
why: Before cataract surgery, and sometimes before other lens surgery.
duration: usually 10 to 20 minutes; results right away
tell_doctor: If you had laser vision correction or other eye surgery
What vision matters most to you after surgery: far or near

prepare.title: Contact lenses
prepare.text: Contact lenses are usually stopped a few days before. The clinic will tell you how long.

prepare.title: Getting home
prepare.text: If your pupils will be widened, it is better not to drive afterward.

bring: Notes from past eye surgery, if any
Someone to go with you, if you will have drops
steps: You sit at the machine with your chin on the stand
The machine measures each eye with light, without touching it
Sometimes ultrasound is used after numbing drops
The doctor calculates the lens power
feel: The light is bright, and you need to look without blinking for a few seconds
after: If you had drops, do not rub your eyes
The result is used to choose your lens
The surgery date is usually set at your visit

faq.q: Why measure if the surgery is standard?
faq.a: Every eye is different. An accurate calculation decides how you will see after surgery.

faq.q: Can I choose a lens so I can read without glasses?
faq.a: Talk to your surgeon. There are different options, and the doctor will suggest the right one.

reminders.text: Eye measurement tomorrow. Take out contact lenses if the clinic told you to. No makeup.
